The role also involves attending client meetings, industry events, and networking activities, tracking business development metrics, and providing regular reports to leadership. The Business Development Professional will collaborate closely with senior management to align business development initiatives with the firm’s strategic goals.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 







* Strong client relationship management and sales skills, including the ability to identify opportunities, negotiate, and close deals.
* Experience in business development, preferably within architecture, interior design, construction, or related professional services.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients, partners, and internal teams.
* Solid research, analytical, and planning abilities to assess markets, develop strategies, and manage a pipeline of prospects.
* Comfort with CRM tools, MS Office or similar productivity software, and basic reporting for tracking business performance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Delhi, collaborate in a team setting, and manage priorities in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Prior experience working with hospitality, retail, or commercial clients is an advantage.

title: Channel Partnerships (Senior Associate / Assistant Manager)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager \- Channel Partnerships**




  





 📍
 *Delhi \| Own and scale college and university partnerships to drive on\-ground activations, lead generation, and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs.* 




  





**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 We’re looking for a Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Channel Partnerships who thrives in high\-ownership, on\-ground roles to build partnerships from scratch and driving real enrolment outcomes. You should be comfortable operating independently, travelling frequently, and engaging senior stakeholders like TPOs, deans, and faculty to create win\-win collaborations.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 You’ll build and scale Kraftshala’s offline acquisition engine by forming partnerships with colleges and institutes across India, starting with Delhi NCR. Your work will directly influence lead flow, enrolments, and revenue, making this a
 **core growth role** 
 \- not a support function.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 




  




* Opportunity to build a partnerships channel from scratch and scale it nationally
* Clear linkage between your work and enrolment/revenue outcomes
* Direct exposure to senior leadership on GTM decisions



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rates, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





 You will own on\-ground partnerships with colleges, universities, and training institutes to drive awareness and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs. This is a field\-heavy, individual contributor role requiring frequent travel, strong stakeholder management, and sharp execution.
 



  





 While the initial focus will be Delhi NCR, deployment will be opportunity\-led with pan\-India scope over time.
 



  





**Specific Responsibilities \& Metrics:** 




  




* Build and manage institutional partnerships.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Number of active college/institute partnerships; depth of engagement per partner; repeat collaborations*
* Plan and execute on\-ground seminars, workshops, and events.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Number of events conducted; attendance quality; lead yield per event*
* Generate and hand over qualified leads to the Admissions team.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Leads generated; lead qualification rate; successful handover and follow\-through*
* Own relationships with TPOs, deans, and faculty stakeholders.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*Stakeholder responsiveness; partnership longevity; referral introductions*
* Track performance and pipeline using CRM tools.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
*CRM hygiene; reporting accuracy; visibility of funnel and outcomes*



  





**Monthly Outcomes**




  





**Month 1:** 



* Onboard fully on Kraftshala’s programs, value proposition, and admissions funnel
* Activate existing college/institute contacts
* Close initial partnerships and execute early seminars/events



  





**Month 2:** 



* Build a predictable cadence of events and partnerships
* Improve lead quality and handover effectiveness
* Identify high\-performing partner profiles and formats



  





**Month 3\+:** 



* Scale partnerships across new geographies based on opportunity
* Drive consistent contribution to enrolments and revenue
* Act as a feedback loop to leadership on on\-ground GTM insights



  





**Top Grading**




  




* **Ownership \& Accountability:** 
 An A\-player independently builds and scales partnerships end\-to\-end, whereas a B\-player waits for direction and external momentum.
* **Stakeholder Influence:** 
 An A\-player earns trust with senior academic stakeholders and creates repeat collaborations, whereas a B\-player struggles to move beyond transactional conversations.
* **Execution Excellence:** 
 An A\-player consistently converts on\-ground activity into qualified leads, whereas a B\-player confuses effort with outcomes.
* **Data Discipline:** 
 An A\-player maintains clean CRM data and clear reporting, whereas a B\-player treats tracking as an afterthought.



  





**Must Haves:**




  




* 2\-5 years of experience in B2B business development. (
 *We are not too fussed about the number of years. Experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care for* 
 ).
* Comfortable with field\-heavy roles and frequent intercity travel
* Proven ability to generate, track, and hand over qualified leads
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and outcome reporting



  





**Good to Haves:**




  




* Prior experience engaging with TPOs, deans, and faculty members
* Existing college or university relationships that can be activated immediately



  





**Selection Process:**

title: Executive - Sales Administration
description:
**KRAs \& Specific Roles**
* Tender Management, Quotation \& Commercial Proposal Management, Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) \& E\-Procurement Portals:

* Prepare, submit, and track tender applications in compliance with Business Guidebook of the company and other policies/ regulatory guidelines.

* List products/services, update pricing, and ensure compliance with GeM guidelines.

* Maintain an up\-to\-date repository of all active and expired agreements.
* Track agreement renewal dates and coordinate timely renewals or terminations.
* Commission Claims Processing:
* Verify and process distributor commission claims as per the terms outlined in agreements.
* Cross\-check sales data, invoices, and claim submissions to ensure accuracy.
* Coordinate with sales, finance, and accounts teams to resolve discrepancies.
* Ensure timely disbursement of commissions and maintain proper financial records.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Knowledge of tendering processes and e\-procurement platforms (GeM, CPP, E\-tender portals).
* Experience in preparing quotations, pricing strategies, and commercial documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and compliance\-oriented mindset.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and ERP/CRM systems.
* Good communication and coordination skills for internal and external stakeholder management.
* Strong knowledge of contract management, distributor agreements, and financial reconciliation.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word), ERP, and CRM systems.
* Good analytical skills to verify commission claims and contract compliance.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills for distributor management.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple agreements simultaneously


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 2\-5 years of experience in tender management, quotation preparation, or commercial operations (preferably in healthcare, medical devices, or government procurement sectors).
* Experience in handling GeM and other government procurement portals.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - West India
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest\-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world\-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI\-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.
 


  


 Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!
 



**Minimum qualifications:**



  

  
* 7\+ years of experience in SaaS/Security sales, selling to Enterprise accounts in West India.
  
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  


  


**Preferred qualifications:**



  

  
* Experience managing accounts in the cloud or cybersecurity ecosystem to elevate the business.
  
* Experience in value\-based solution selling, focusing on delivering tangible business outcomes and ensuring alignment with end business value.
  
* Proven track record in complex sales cycles, including multi\-stakeholder negotiations within the West India geographical territory.
  
* Experience executing a formal sales process and familiarity with qualification frameworks (such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message).
  
* Experience partnering with sales engineering to drive technical evaluations.
  
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
  
* Experience working cross\-functionally with marketing, product, customer success, and sales operations teams.
  
* Exceptional communication, operational command, and strategic thinking skills.
  
* A consultative and professional approach to engaging with customers.
  


  


**About the job:**



  



 As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive new and build on existing business through large\-scale adoption of our cloud security solutions within our enterprise segment. This role will be reporting to the Regional Director, Sales \- West India. You will lead highly strategic sales cycles, engaging with technical and executive stakeholders to solve complex security challenges and influence long\-term security strategies. You will work alongside a team of Wizards that focus on our customers' business needs. Our priority is building a secure infrastructure for their cloud environments. We do that by learning their business. We ask questions. We listen. We help educate.
 



  


**Responsibilities:**



  

  
* Develop and execute territory strategies to drive revenue growth within Enterprise accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas, in a way that reflects Wiz values.
  
* Demonstrate an intimate understanding of Wiz Cloud Security Solutions and their value to our customers.
  
* Position and advise CISO\-level executives with industry Point\-of\-View business insights, continuing to listen, build, and grow executive relationships with customers.
  
* Conduct deep research and account planning to engage senior security decision\-makers.
  
* Lead multi\-threaded sales engagements, collaborating with technical buyers and executive sponsors.
  
* Align with the Wiz partner ecosystem to optimize market opportunity.
  
* Build effective working relationships with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Delivery, and Executive teams to ensure strategy alignment and achieve company objectives.

title: Ruminants Technical Sales Engineer
description:
IDENA is an innovative French company with more than 30 years of experience in dairy animal nutrition. As a pioneer in phytogenic feed additives, we develop solutions that improve feed efficiency, enhance animal performance, and reduce environmental impact.
 



  





**POSITION SUMMARY** 




  
 




 \- Develop sales of IDENA’s ruminants’ products throughout India, in accordance with the sales strategy defined by Sales Direction in France
 





 \-
 
 Promote IDENA's solutions to feed manufacturers and medium\- and large\-sized dairy farms, as well as consultants, nutritionists and KOL
 



 \- Implement the action plans proposed by the Sales Department
 



 \- Support technically the Indian Exclusive Distributor as well its sub\-distributors and partners
 



  
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 









**1\. Sales development** 









 \- Develop and implement the sales strategy in the territory
 



 \- Prospect for and identify potential customers, first and foremost feed millers, but also medium and large size dairy farms
 



 \- Prioritize the production regions with the greatest potential
 



 \- Work closely with the Indian Exclusive Distributor, as well as IDENA’s Sales Direction in France
 



 \- Attend trade shows, conferences, and professional events on request of the Indian Exclusive Distributor and IDENA’s Sales Direction in France
 



 \- Meet the objectives set by the Sales Direction
 



 \- Monitor the competition and report findings internally
 



 \- Provide reports in English in accordance with the Sales Direction expectations
 



 \- Ensure customers’ financial solvency
 



  
 



**2\. Technical Support in cooperation with and with the support of IDENA’s Ruminants team in France** 










 Support nutritionists, consultants, feed millers and farmers
 









 \- Provide technical presentations on the products to various stakeholders (consultants, nutritionists, feed mills, KOLs, medium\- and large\-scale dairy farms)
 



 \- Demonstrate the economic and zootechnical benefits of IDENA’s products through formulation simulations with feed formulation software and/or rationing software
 



 \- Conduct farm assessments and audits (zootechnical performance, feeding practices, housing conditions)
 



 \- Propose tailored technical recommendations (nutrition, farm management, integration of IDENA products)
 



 \- Monitor performance and adjust action plans
 



  
 




 Support the Indian Exclusive Distributor and its sub\-distributors
 









 \- Strengthen the local technical\-sales teams’ product knowledge (sales pitches, benefits, unique selling points)
 



 \- Provide regular technical support to distributors and sub\-distributors in promoting and using IDENA solutions
 



 \- Design and lead technical training sessions for distributor and sub\-distributors teams, consultants, nutritionists, and end users.
 



 \- Provide support during strategic meetings with end customers
 









 Implement and Monitor Field Trials
 









 \- Define and implement field trial protocols in collaboration with local partners
 



 \- Monitor the proper execution of the trials and the reliability of the data collected
 



 \- Analyze the results and document the technical conclusions for commercial application 
 



  





**REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS** 




  
 



 \-   Degree in Animal Production Engineering or Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
 



 \-   Technical background in Ruminants animal nutrition
 



 \-   Proficiency in feed formulation software and rationing software
 



 \-  At least 5 years of proven experience in selling additives to feed mills in India for another European supplier of feed additives
 



 \- In\-depth knowledge of the dairy feed sector in India, with an extensive network of feed millers, consultants, and nutritionists
 



 \-   Proven skills and a passion for selling high\-value\-added technical solutions
 



 \-   Strong interpersonal skills
 



 \-   Ability to analyze and synthesize information
 



 \-   Ability to persuade others
 



 \-   Ability to work independently
 



 \-   Attention to detail
 



 \-   Enjoy working as part of a team
 



 \-   Diplomacy
 



 \-   Enjoys taking on challenges
 



 \-   Fluent in English
 








**REPORTING STRUCTURE / FUNCTIONAL ROLE** 




  
 



 Reports to Sales Director, IDENA France
 



 Cross\-functional relationships:
 



 \- IDENA's Ruminants Team in France
 



 \- General Manager of the exclusive distributor in India

description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**
 The Enterprise Account Manager (AM) role is focused on owning, retaining, and expanding a defined book of strategic executive through structured farming, deep customer engagement, and long\-term value creation. This role emphasizes account growth with success driven by multi\-product expansion, renewal strength, and durable executive relationships.
   

  

 You will work with complex, global accounts within engineering\-led organizations, partnering closely with internal teams to unlock expansion opportunities across usage, teams, and product lines. This role reports to the Sales Manager.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
 We are looking for a seasoned Account Manager with a strong track record of expansion\-led revenue ownership in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
   

  

* 8 \- 10 years of B2B SaaS experience, with 3\-4 years of experience in a farming / Account Management focused role
* Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding expansion, renewal, and net revenue retention targets
* Recent experience explicitly aligned to Account Management, Farming, Expansion, Upsell / Cross\-sell
* Willingness to work region\-aligned time zones, based on customer coverage
* Passionate about tech and SaaS; extreme customer centricity and empathy; strong desire to work in a fast\-paced, self\-directed start\-up environment
* Solid understanding of Software SaaS/ SaaS adjacent business models and a high degree of comfort and skill in selling to and engaging with technical audiences and executive\-level stakeholders.
* Global Market Experience (Preferred): Previous exposure or success in international sales and account management will be considered a significant plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering / Technology background preferred


**What Will You Do?**
**Account Ownership, Expansion \& Lifecycle Expertise**
* Own a portfolio of Enterprsie customers with accountability for long\-term revenue growth and retention.
* Strong understanding of upsell, cross\-sell, and renewal mechanics across multi\-product SaaS portfolios
* Proven ability to identify expansion levers using usage data, customer maturity, org structure, and business goals


**Executive \& Technical Engagement**
* Ability to engage confidently with engineering leaders, technical stakeholders, and economic buyers
* Strong grasp of SaaS business models and comfort selling into technical organizations


**Own \& Grow Strategic Accounts and Build Customer Partnerships**
* Engage customers through regular in\-person meetings, including onsite visits, to strengthen relationships and accelerate account growth
* Own a defined book of strategic accounts with full responsibility for retention, expansion, and net revenue growth
* Develop trusted relationships with technical user, and executive stakeholders


**Drive Renewal \& Retention Excellence**
* Ensure predictable renewals by reinforcing value, outcomes, and ROI ahead of contract milestones.
* Identify and mitigate renewal or contraction risks in partnership with Internal teams.


**Operate Cross\-Functionally with Rigor**
* Act as the central point of ownership across internal teams
* Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene to support forecasting and decision\-making


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves

title: Manager - Corporate Sales & Memberships
description:
Maniac Sportz runs 19 venues and 41 courts across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Thane. Our flagship, Maniac Pickleball Arena at Vile Parle West, has 12 covered courts and never closes. We are looking for our first dedicated corporate sales hire.
 



  





 The job in one line: fill courts that never close, by selling to the companies, societies and schools within 5 km of them.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



 Corporate accounts. Offices in Vile Parle, Andheri, BKC and Goregaon that need offsites, team events, wellness programmes and Friday\-evening leagues. You find them, pitch them, close them and keep them.
 



 Memberships. Turn one\-time players into monthly members. Build the packages, price them with the founder, sell them.
 



 Bulk and block bookings. Housing societies, schools, academies, corporate tournaments. Our quiet hours \- weekday mornings and late nights \- are your inventory.
 



 The pipeline itself. There is no CRM today. You will set one up and run it.
 



 Renewals and referrals. A member who brings three friends is worth more than three cold leads. Build that loop.
 



  





 What we are looking for
 



 2\-5 years in B2B sales, memberships, hospitality, events or fitness. Sport is a plus, not a requirement \- we can teach pickleball, we cannot teach hustle.
 



 You are comfortable walking into an office lobby without an appointment.
 



 Mumbai\-based, and you actually know the western suburbs.
 



 Fluent in English and Hindi. Marathi helps.
 



 Comfortable being measured on a number every month, and willing to work some evenings and weekends. That is when a sports venue is alive.
 



  





 What you get
 



 Fixed salary plus uncapped commission on everything you close.
 



 Direct reporting to the founder. No layers, no politics, decisions the same day.
 



 First sales hire, which means you shape the function rather than inherit it.
 



 Free court access and coaching. Obviously.
 



  





 Who this is not for
 



 If you want a defined territory, a mature playbook and a manager who checks in weekly, this is the wrong job. This role is closer to founding a sales team than joining one.
 



  





 How to apply: apply through LinkedIn and tell us, in three lines, about the hardest thing you have ever sold. We read every one.

title: Sales Executive - Bangalore
description:
Prakruti Plus is a Social Business Model in the Catalyst Management Services platform, built to make climate\-smart solutions commercially available to small producers and low\-income households. It brings proven technologies — cold chain, clean cooking, solar and allied products to the last mile through a network of community entrepreneurs and collective enterprises. Prakruti Plus therefore combines product supply, financing linkage and after\-sales support resulting in improved livelihoods and healthy days.
 




**Purpose of the role** 





 Drive primary and secondary sales of Prakruti Plus climate solutions through the community organisations, FPCs, cooperatives or SHG federations.
 





 The role owns revenue conversion at the last mile: turning demand generated on the platform into paid orders, realised collections and repeat purchase.
 




**Scope of work** 





 1\. Sales delivery
 



* Own the sales funnel end to end ; lead generation, demonstration, quotation, negotiation, order closure, delivery coordination , collection, after sales service and insight generation on additional products required by the community.
* Convert institutional and aggregated demand into confirmed orders.
* Maintain a live, stage\-wise pipeline




 2\. Channel and franchisee activation
 



* Recruit, onboard and activate community entrepreneurs and channel partners; support them until they reach independent selling capability.
* Ensure community organisation unit economics are explained and understood — commission structures, margins and payment terms
* Run periodic channel reviews covering stock position, ageing, dormant agents and dropout reasons.




 3\. Customer and market intelligence
 



* Capture competitor pricing, product gaps, objections and rejection reasons and feed these back to the business and to innovator partners.
* Validate whether stated customer willingness to pay converts into actual payment, segment by segment.




 4\. Financing linkage
 



* Work with the inclusive finance and cooperative arms of the platform to structure affordable payment options where product cost exceeds customer liquidity.
* Coordinate with financing partners on documentation and disbursement.




 5\. Data discipline 
 



* Record every lead, visit, quotation and closure in the platform data system within the agreed cycle.



**Deliverables** 



* Monthly sales and collection report against plan, by product and by channel.
* Active pipeline dashboard, refreshed weekly.
* Quarterly territory plan: target segments, named accounts, channel additions, expected conversion.
* Post\-sale service and satisfaction feedback for a sample of customers each quarter.
* Quarterly market intelligence note covering pricing, competition, product performance and adoption barriers. Community feedback on other products required.



**Performance indicators** 



* Order value and volume closed
* Number of active, transacting channel partners
* Conversion rate from qualified lead to closed sale
* Repeat purchase rate and referral\-led sales
* Data completeness and timeliness
* Customer complaint resolution turnaround



**Person specification** 





 Essential
 



* Three to six years in field sales, preferably rural or semi\-urban distribution — agri\-inputs, appliances, solar, dairy equipment, FMCG or micro\-finance and with community organisations, FPCs, cooperatives or SHG federations.
* Demonstrated record of closing sales and recovering payments
* Comfort with commercial arithmetic: margins, landed cost, EMI, customer break\-even.
* Kannada and English; Tamil or Telugu an advantage depending on territory.
* Willingness to travel 15–20 days a month.
* Familiarity with CRM or mobile data capture tools.
* Exposure to credit\-linked or subsidy\-linked product sales.

description:

**Account Executive – Mid\-Market \- IND**
**Build Your Career with One of the World’s Leading SaaS Companies**
**Ready for a bigger challenge?**
 You’ve proven you can sell.
   

  

 You’ve exceeded quota, built pipeline from scratch and won new business. Now you’re looking for the next step. At UKG, you’ll move beyond selling to small businesses and work with Indian organisations employing
 **1,000–5,000 people** 
 , partnering with senior HR, Finance, IT and business leaders to modernise how they manage, engage and optimise their workforce. More importantly, you’ll join one of the world’s largest and most successful SaaS companies, where high\-performing Account Executives build long\-term careers—not just hit quarterly numbers.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.
   

  

 UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.
   

  

**Disability Accommodation** 
 in the Application and Interview Process
   

  

 For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com
   

  

 This isn’t just a Mid\-Market sales role.
   

  

 It’s an opportunity to step into strategic selling.
   

  

 You’ll own a territory of Indian organisations with
 **1,000–5,000 employees** 
 , managing complex HR technology sales opportunities, engaging executive stakeholders and helping customers move from manual, fragmented or legacy processes to modern, connected and data\-driven workforce solutions.
   

  

 You’ll be trusted to own your territory while being supported by experienced leaders, Solution Consultants, Marketing and Business Development teams that help you succeed.
   

  

 If your goal is Enterprise Sales in the future, this is exactly the type of experience that gets you there.
   

  

**Selling HR Tech in India**
 Selling HR technology in India requires more than product knowledge. It requires the ability to understand how organisations are scaling, where HR processes are becoming complex, and how leaders think about compliance, productivity, employee experience and ROI.
   

  

 You’ll work with fast\-growing and established businesses—including promoter\-led companies, GCCs and organisations with distributed or frontline workforces—helping them improve payroll accuracy, workforce visibility, manager effectiveness and employee experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 You’ll own the entire customer journey.
   

  

* Build and execute your territory strategy.
* Prospect and generate your own pipeline through outbound activity and referrals.
* Run consultative discovery with HR, Finance, Operations and Executive stakeholders.
* Engage CHROs, CFOs, CIOs, HR operations leaders, payroll teams and business heads across complex buying committees.
* Build compelling business cases around productivity, compliance, payroll accuracy, workforce visibility, employee experience and measurable ROI.
* Lead complex buying committees through the entire sales cycle.
* Create land\-and\-expand strategies by identifying initial high\-impact use cases and building a pathway for broader HCM and Workforce Management transformation.
* Negotiate and close new business.
* Deliver accurate forecasting through Salesforce.
* Work with Solution Consultants, Marketing, Business Development teams, partners and ecosystem influencers to build market presence and progress opportunities.
* Consistently exceed your sales targets.


**Who We’re Looking For**
 This role is ideal for someone who’s already successful and wants to accelerate their career.
   

  

**You’ll Probably Have**
* 5\+ years of success in SaaS sales or running your own successful business.
* A track record of exceeding quota.
* Strong outbound prospecting skills.
* The ability to open doors in greenfield accounts and create urgency where HR transformation may not yet be budgeted.
* Experience running full sales cycles.
* Confidence presenting to senior decision\-makers.
* A consultative approach to selling.
* Comfort navigating price\-sensitive, ROI\-driven buying environments with multiple business and technology stakeholders.
* A genuine desire to continue learning and growing.
* Experience managing consultative SaaS sales cycles.
* Exposure to industries with large, distributed or frontline workforces—such as manufacturing, retail, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, BFSI, IT/ITES or GCCs—would be an advantage.
* Experience selling HR technology, payroll, Workforce Management, HCM, ERP, employee experience platforms or other enterprise SaaS solutions will be highly valued.


 You don’t need Enterprise Sales experience.
   

  

 You do need the ambition to get there.
   

  

**Why Sales Professionals Stay at UKG**
 We believe great salespeople want more than a good commission plan.
   

  

 They want to keep growing.
   

  

**At UKG You’ll Benefit From**
* A recognised global brand that opens doors.
* Award\-winning HCM and Workforce Management solutions.
* World\-class sales enablement and coaching.
* Genuine career pathways into Enterprise, Strategic and Global Account sales.
* High\-performing leaders who invest in your development.
* Hybrid working flexibility.
* Uncapped commissions and accelerators.
* Outstanding employee benefits, including U Choose, wellbeing programs, tuition reimbursement and paid volunteering.


 Your Next Chapter Starts Here
   

  

 If you’re ready to sell bigger deals, work with larger customers and build a career with one of the world’s leading SaaS companies, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Join UKG and help organisations become great places to work—while building a career you’ll be proud of.

 Master's Degree

* Strong Technical Acumen: A solid understanding of data streaming concepts, Kafka, and the Confluent platform. Ability to effectively communicate technical value to both technical and business audiences.

* Excellent Communication and Presentation Skills: Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts and deliver compelling sales presentations.
* Strong Business Value Skills: Proven ability to justify favorable agreements that align with Confluent's business objectives.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Axis Max Life Insurance Limited (formerly Max Life Insurance Company Limited) is a joint venture between Max Financial Services Limited, part of the Indian multi\-business Max Group, and Axis Bank Limited. The company offers comprehensive protection and long\-term savings life insurance solutions through a multichannel distribution network, including agency and third\-party partners. It has a strong track record of reliability, with an individual death claims paid ratio of 99\.8% as per audited financials for FY25\-26\. Axis Max Life Insurance Limited manages Rs. 200,000 crore in assets under management and has a sum assured in force of Rs. 2,191,857 crore, reflecting its scale and stability. The organization has grown over nearly two decades through a need\-based sales process, a customer\-centric service approach, and investment in trained human capital.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The role involves identifying and developing new business opportunities, building and managing relationships with distribution partners, corporate clients, and key stakeholders, and driving sales growth for life insurance products. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting client meetings and presentations, and supporting the design of tailored insurance solutions that align with customer needs. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with internal teams such as sales, marketing, and operations to ensure effective execution of business plans and achievement of revenue targets. The role also includes monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and performance metrics to refine strategies and contribute to long\-term business expansion.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Proven business development, sales, and client relationship management skills in financial services or insurance.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities, with capacity to engage diverse stakeholders.
* Strategic thinking, market analysis, and planning capabilities to identify and pursue growth opportunities.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and meet defined targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Knowledge of life insurance products, distribution channels, and regulatory environment is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office, and data\-driven decision\-making in day\-to\-day work.
* Demonstrated integrity, customer\-centric mindset, and readiness to work on\-site in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward\-thinking businesses.
   

  

 We are seeking aSenior Sales Engineer to sit at the intersection of enterprise software strategy, hands\-on systems architecture, and advanced AI automation. This is not a traditional generalist presales role. This is a role built for highly technical builders who are deeply curious about how autonomous agents, security, analytics, and deep integrations fundamentally transform how enterprise work gets done. You will own the technical strategy for our global customer engagements, acting as a strategic advisor to both the C\-suite and engineering leadership.
   

  

 Why This Role? Why Now?
   

  

* Drive the AI Revolution: Step into an elite presales environment where you will directly architect the deployment of modern Agentic AI workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) for top global enterprises.
* Strategic Scope: Evolve your career by expanding your enterprise influence by presenting technical value narratives directly to economic buyers and C\-level stakeholders.
* Innovative Culture: Work within an ecosystem designed to optimize human potential through advanced digital tools, where continuous learning, curiosity, and experimentation are hardwired into our daily performance.


 Who We're Looking For
   

  

 We are looking for a highly technical Individual Contributor who operates with considerable judgment and initiative. You understand the complex operational and financial implications of architecture choices and can confidently design customized enterprise\-grade solutions. You have a passion for clean system configurations, combined with a sharp commercial mindset that links technical capabilities directly to business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Architect Agentic AI \& Integration Workflows: Design, build, and operationalize advanced, agentic AI\-driven customer workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), deep prompt engineering, and modern automation frameworks.
* Lead Technical Architecture Discovery: Conduct rigorous, deep\-dive technical discovery and AI readiness assessments. Translate complex system requirements into scalable pilots and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs) and enterprise\-grade pilots that demonstrate clear business value.
* Build Scalable Accelerators: Proactively develop production\-ready, reusable technical accelerators, middleware templates, and open\-source\-aligned API components that allow regional teams and Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Zendesk solutions at scale.
* Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Serve as the absolute technical authority from qualification through execution. Architect secure, scalable topologies leveraging Zendesk APIs, webhook frameworks, and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Bridge Product \& Field Strategy: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering to provide real\-world, technical feedback from the field, identifying product gaps and shaping the future roadmap of Zendesk's core AI and platform ecosystem.


**What You Bring To The Role (Basic Qualifications)**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related highly quantitative technical discipline is required.
* Experience: 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in technical presales, solution engineering, or a system architect/developer role within enterprise SaaS or complex software environments.
* Technical Fluency: Deep expertise with modern web and scripting technologies (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript), REST/SOAP APIs, middleware frameworks, and cloud ecosystem architectures.
* AI/ML Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous agent deployment.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure, contact center tech stacks (CCaaS, telephony, workforce management), or modern IT Service Management (ITSM) systems.
* Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel between 30% and 50% annually to lead critical, high\-touch on\-site customer architecture sessions and strategic regional briefings.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A Master’s degree or professional technical cloud/AI certifications.
* Active engagement in the technical or developer community (e.g., open\-source contributions, technical blogging, or community mentorship).
* Proven track record of designing reusable implementation guides, integration playbooks, or localization toolkits for global delivery partners and systems integrators.
* Experience flattening complex technical narratives into high\-impact presentations tailored for executive, economic buyers and C\-level stakeholders.


 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
   

  

 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
   

  

 As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
   

  

 Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, \& inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
   

  

 Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e\-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.
